increments.title: The germinal products overview page, with packages and kilograms commodity totals and its Commodity details completeness rule
increments.detail: A trader filling in a germinal products notification needs an overview of their own notification, so they can see its reference and status, what is left to do and where to go next. The germinal set gets its own overview page, keyed by the notification just as the live animals overview is, carrying the same heading, status, numbered task list and end buttons. Germinal products are counted by packages and by weight rather than by head of animal, so the commodity totals block shows a packages card and a kilograms card instead of the animals card, and the kilograms card totals the gross weight entered for the consignment and rounds it the same way wherever that total is shown. Screen-reader users get the same named regions as on the live animals overview, with the weight card named for the gross weight the set holds. Because germinal lines are counted by packages, the Commodity details task is complete once every chosen species has a valid number of packages and any total gross weight entered is valid; the weight and the temperature are optional, so leaving either blank does not hold the task back. The live animals overview keeps the cards it shows today.

increments.detail: Germinal products becomes a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted beside it with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, routing and set services. Its journey pages use the live-animals slugs under the germinal mount, each a copy of its live-animals page plus the germinal differences. Every answer the live-animals set asks is carried over except the two the notification data specification marks for the animals journey alone, the county parish holding number and the permanent address, so the germinal set never asks them. Both sets keep their notifications in the one animals backend, so the stored record is what tells them apart: the backend's create takes the category the set starting the notification sends and holds it at the root of the record, no later save, submit, amend, cancel-amend or copy changes it, and a record with no category is read as live animals so every notification stored before the germinal set existed keeps working without a data migration. The read the frontend opens a notification with hands the category back, so each set's entry guard refuses the other category's notifications. A trader moving between the two sets must see one service, so every germinal page carries the same service navigation, phase banner, footer, browser-title pattern, section captions, back links, error summary and banners, with the home links resolving inside the germinal set. This row lays the set down and proves it with its first page: starting a germinal notification creates a draft with the same kind of reference a live-animals notification gets and lands on the set's own copy of the origin page, which asks the four origin answers the live-animals page asks. The set's end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit in the animals test project rather than a project of their own, and the high-risk plants journey gets no germinal pages at all.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a germinal products notification from the germinal set's own start creates a notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip from the first page, and lands on the set's 'Origin of the import' page. increments.title: Germinal Commodity details checks the weight and the number of packages, and lists its errors by question
increments.detail: The germinal set's Commodity details page checks the figures it asks for. A total gross weight, when given, must be a number greater than 0, at most 1,000 kilograms and to no more than two decimal places. A number of packages is required and must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000. Where Design Release 2.1 gives the message it is used, and the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern for a maximum. A germinal trader fixing several species should read one question at a time, so the page lists every total gross weight error before every number of packages error, species by species, each linked to its own field. The total gross weight and the storage temperature are optional on this set, so a blank weight and an unanswered temperature save and raise no error, and only the weight and the package count can put a message in the summary.
acceptanceCriteria: A total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. increments.title: A germinal products notification picks its transporter from the germinal set's own transporter list

increments.title: The journey tells a hard stop from a submission check, and keeps a group of answers all-or-nothing
increments.detail: The notification's data specification marks each answer as mandatory to proceed, mandatory to submit, optional or conditional, and marks some answers as a group that is filled in together. The journey's obligation model carries only mandatory or optional today, and a mandatory answer is held back to the submission check while each page's own hard stops are written into the page, so the two kinds of mandatory cannot be told apart and a half-filled group can be stored. After this row the model carries all four markings and the all-or-nothing group, and judges each one where the answer applies: on the notification, on a commodity line or on a unit. A trader is then stopped on the page only by an answer the specification makes a hard stop, is told at submission about an answer that only holds submission back, and can never store half of a group. The high-risk plants journey shares the model and takes the same change.
acceptanceCriteria: An answer the notification data specification marks mandatory to proceed must be given before its page can be left: every save control the page offers refuses a blank answer with an error naming it in the error summary and inline, the trader stays on the page with what they entered still shown, and nothing is saved. An answer the specification marks mandatory to submit can be left blank while the notification is being filled in, so every save control on its page saves and moves on with it blank, and the notification cannot be submitted until it is given, with each one still missing named when the trader tries to submit. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-016; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-143)

increments.title: The high-risk plants set's rulings records carry the decisions now in force
increments.detail: The plants set keeps its rulings in one ledger, and every entry of its conflicts register and every behaviour of its journey specification points at that ledger rather than holding an answer of its own. Decisions taken since the set's own sittings change plants behaviours that earlier ledger entries settled, and not one of them is in the ledger, so the set's own record reads the opposite of what is being built and anybody changing a plants page cannot tell what has already been ruled. Bringing the ledger and the register up to date by the set's own change procedure gives every later plants change one place to record its ruling.
acceptanceCriteria: A decision that changes a high-risk plants behaviour an earlier ledger entry settled is held in the set's decisions ledger as a new numbered entry whose status reads current, naming who decided it, the date it was decided and the entry it supersedes (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:25-35; src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json)

Each ledger entry one of those decisions replaces stays in the ledger with its status reading superseded and names the entry that replaced it (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/decisions.json:136-138)

Each subject one of those entries settles reads the resolution now in force: a conflict carries that resolution, who resolved it and the new entry's number, and a behaviour carries its status, the new entry's number and the resolution appended to its detail (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:25-35)

Each entry of the set's conflicts register whose disagreement one of those decisions settles points at that decision's ledger entry for the answer, and reads that entry's resolution and who made it (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/conflicts.json; src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:5-6)

The set's review-panel dockets and critic entries carry the arguments they already carry, and the ledger and its subjects are the only records a changed ruling rewrites (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/panel/README.md:25-35)

Re-stamping a behaviour subject edits the set's journey specification, which inc-278 also rewrites, so this row builds before it.

increments.title: The high-risk plants set's guides describe the journey the service serves
increments.detail: The set's own record of documentation drift treats a document stating something the service does not do as a defect, because a second, false specification gets read as though it were current. The served-surface reference, the guide to the set's features, the guide to the journey's flow and the table of each page's copy state all describe the journey as it stood before this work. Bringing each one to what the service does, and writing into the set's documentation that a guide changes in the same increment as the behaviour it describes, puts the drift right and stops it returning.

The guide to the set's features describes how a page ends, and what a draft's and a submitted notification's view header carries, as the service has them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/features.md:95, 178)

The guide to the journey's flow lists the journey's sections, its task rows in the order the overview lists them, where Back goes on every journey page, and which pages carry which caption, as the journey's flow has them (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/docs/journey-flow-and-gates.md:21, 63, 111, 248)

The set's documentation states that a guide describing a behaviour of the journey changes in the same increment as that behaviour (repo:plantsfrontend src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/spec/backlog-extras.json increment docs-drift-sweep)
notes: New on this re-distil. One slice: the four guides describe one journey and a reader checks them together, so correcting them apart would repeat the same walk of the journey four times. It builds after inc-278 so the specification and the guides are read against the same journey once.
The set's testing guide is left alone: it is the split-off test-hygiene branch's to change, and this theme's touches leave it out.
